_comment: Two records from two once-only top-level literals in one array; the program provides boxes[0] as an unrelated Config service and passes boxes[1], holding only a string, to a Schedule whose callback calls the method of a captured service the string names. Array reads merge the elements, so each record may be the provided one, but only boxes[0] is: the named method stays, the unread one is removed and the bundle runs. Guards that the Schedule input filter drops only definite services.
